description: Use when scheduling a meeting across time zones. Input: zones (2-10, IANA or KST/PST/CET), date, work_start/work_end (default 09:00-18:00), include_weekends. Output: JSON overlap windows in UTC and every zone's local time, top 3 one-hour slots ranked by distance from each zone's day edges, partial windows when no full overlap, next DST change per zone. Example: ?zones=America/New_York,Europe/London,Asia/Seoul&date=2026-11-03 Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

date.description: Meeting date YYYY-MM-DD in the anchor zone (default today UTC)

work_end.description: Local end of working hours, HH:MM

work_start.description: Local start of working hours, HH:MM

zones.description: 2–10 time zones, comma-separated; the first is the anchor whose local date is scanned

name: time_overlap
title: Meeting time finder: working-hour overlap across time zones, ranked slots, DST-aware
